style: Use case: stylized-concept. One finished, original full-bleed card illustration for the fantasy deckbuilding game Panlibrarium. Painterly dark fantasy book illustration, rich oil and gouache brushwork, tangible aged brass, bone parchment and deep ink, sophisticated dramatic chiaroscuro, restrained luminous magic, atmospheric depth. A compelling concrete scene with a single strong focal silhouette, immediately readable when small, not a diagram or icon. Landscape 3:2. Keep key subject in central 70%, no important details near edges. No card frame, no text or lettering or readable writing, no numbers, no UI, no logo, no watermark. No flat vector art, no modern objects, no gore. New standalone artwork.

biomes.LIBRARY: Ancient impossible library, midnight indigo ink and amber candlelight, quills and books become tangible magic.
biomes.VIKING: Mythic Norse world, icy fjords, weathered iron, pale blue northern light and ember amber; Scandinavian saga atmosphere.
biomes.GREEK: Mythic ancient Greek world, marble, bronze, laurel, Mediterranean azure and warm white stone; epic classical atmosphere.
biomes.EGYPTIAN: Mythic ancient Egyptian world, sandstone, lapis lazuli, gold, papyrus, turquoise magic and desert light.
biomes.LOVECRAFTIAN: Cosmic horror drowned library, impossible stone geometry, dark teal, eerie muted violet and sea green. Dread rather than gore.
biomes.AZTEC: Mythic Mesoamerican fantasy world, obsidian, jade, stepped stone temples, quetzal feathers, sun gold against deep jungle green.
biomes.CELTIC: Mythic Celtic world, ancient oak woodland, mist, moss, bronze, knotwork, luminous pale green and warm manuscript gold.
biomes.RUSSIAN: Slavic folklore world, snowbound birch forest, carved timber, frost silver and cold cobalt with ember red; medieval fairy-tale atmosphere.
biomes.AFRICAN: Mythic West African inspired fantasy world, baobab groves, woven cloth, carved wood, bronze, indigo and warm ochre, dignified oral storytellers and ancestral magic.
